Title: Architecture review gate D
Purpose: Stop after consolidation, workspace decomposition, and schema hygiene to decide whether the module is now architecturally strong enough for final closure proof.
Deliverables: Explicit pass/fail decision covering consolidation, UI decomposition, and schema hygiene.
Corrective subbundle if the gate fails.
ValidationCommands: Review the latest execution-report rows, browser proof for subbundle 13, and build/migration proof for subbundle 14.
ReviewQuestions: Did consolidation reduce duplication without creating a dumping ground?
Is the workspace materially easier to reason about now?
Are schema and provider snapshots/migrations coherent and auditable?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a gate-D corrective subbundle from `subbundles/_corrective-workspace-and-shared-infrastructure-reset` or `subbundles/_corrective-template`, block the queue, and rerun gate D after the correction lands.
